court: In the High Court of Madras

judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

M. Duraiswamy, J.:— When the Civil Revision Petitions were listed for hearing on 16.09.2019, there was no representation on behalf of the petitioner. Hence, the matter was adjourned to 18.09.2019. On 18.09.2019 also, there was no representation for the petitioner and therefore, the Registry was directed to list the matter under the caption “for dismissal” on 19.09.2019 (i.e.) today. Today also, though the matter has been listed under the caption “for dismissal”, none appeared for the petitioner. Hence, this Court has no other option, except to dismiss the Civil Revision Petitions for non-prosecution. Accordingly, the Civil Revision Petitions are dismissed for non-prosecution. No costs.
